channel.title: CVE Daily — AI Curated
channel.description: Today's vulnerability landscape is defined by widespread critical flaws targeting Windows infrastructure, cloud environments, and consumer IoT devices, with a heavy concentration of remote code execution and authentication bypass risks. Microsoft ecosystems face severe pressure as dozens of high-severity issues emerge in core components like Remote Desktop, DHCP, DNS, and Edge, while Azure services including Key Vault, App Service, and DNS contain multiple CVSS 10 vulnerabilities that could allow full account and data compromise. Additionally, unauthenticated remote code execution in Wavlink router firmware and actively exploited access control weaknesses in Active Directory Federation Services and SharePoint pose immediate threats to network integrity and enterprise identity management, demanding urgent remediation across endpoints, cloud workloads, and network perimeters.
